name: Regularization (Ridge / Lasso / Elastic Net)
when_to_use: Linear/logistic regression with many candidate predictors and risk of overfitting or multicollinearity; penalizes large coefficients (Ridge), zeroes out the least useful (Lasso) or combines both (Elastic Net).
notes: Versions of linear regression that penalize barely useful variables, avoiding a "memorized" model and helping to select predictors. Applications: many candidate variables and few observations (e.g., survey data).

expected_input.question: Which predictors really matter when there are many candidates and a risk of overfitting?

plain_explanation.purpose: Does regression with many factors 'taming' weights so as not to memorize noise.
plain_explanation.when_to_use_plain: When there are many factors, some redundant, and ordinary regression becomes unstable.
plain_explanation.data_needed: A table with a numeric response and many factor columns.
plain_explanation.example: Predict real-estate prices with 50 features, selecting the ones that matter.
plain_explanation.diagram: many factors -> penalize large weights -> few factors remain (Lasso zeroes)
